# The Davis Group

> The Davis Group is a luxury real estate team serving the Palos Verdes Peninsula and Beach Cities of Southern California. Led by Bill Davis, the team specializes in Palos Verdes Estates, Rancho Palos Verdes, Rolling Hills, Rolling Hills Estates, Manhattan Beach, Hermosa Beach, Redondo Beach, and the Hollywood Riviera. Approximately 40% of sales are off-market, giving network members access to properties unavailable through traditional channels.

## About

The Davis Group operates out of Palm Realty Boutique in Palos Verdes, California. Bill Davis has over 15 years of experience and is ranked by HomeLight as a top listing agent in Palos Verdes Estates and among the top 16% of agents who sell homes fastest in the region.

## Neighborhood Pages

- [Palos Verdes Estates](https://thedavisgroup.netlify.app/palos-verdes-estates.html): Ocean bluff estates, golf club, Malaga Cove Plaza, top-ranked schools.
- [Rancho Palos Verdes](https://thedavisgroup.netlify.app/rancho-palos-verdes.html): Coastal bluffs, nature preserve, diverse price points, Terranea Resort.
- [Rolling Hills](https://thedavisgroup.netlify.app/rolling-hills.html): Gated community, 1-acre minimum lots, equestrian trails, zero commercial development.
- [Rolling Hills Estates](https://thedavisgroup.netlify.app/rolling-hills-estates.html): Equestrian community, The Shoppes at PV, top-rated schools, family neighborhoods.
- [Manhattan Beach](https://thedavisgroup.netlify.app/manhattan-beach.html): The Strand, award-winning schools, downtown dining, beach volleyball.
- [Hermosa Beach](https://thedavisgroup.netlify.app/hermosa-beach.html): Pier Avenue, the Greenbelt Trail, Fiesta Hermosa, walkable lifestyle.
- [Redondo Beach](https://thedavisgroup.netlify.app/redondo-beach.html): King Harbor Marina, Riviera Village, coastal bike path, waterfront dining.
- [Hollywood Riviera](https://thedavisgroup.netlify.app/hollywood-riviera.html): Santa Monica Bay views, Torrance USD schools, mid-century architecture, Peninsula access.
